consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

facts.title: energy isolation failure on ZV-7210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on ZV-7210 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on ZV-7210 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. ZV-7210 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 16 May 2021 an incident occurred on ZV-7210 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during cleaning and preparation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
